'''Mawbo's Performance Hall''' was a dance hall in [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] that was owned by [[Mawbo Kem]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="TG" />
